anya: Heads-up: private deployment reported missing model variant q4_1 for customer X. How should adapter behave by default?
lee: We should NOT auto-route to hosted unless manifest explicitly opts in. Data residency + KMS are blocking concerns.
sam: Agreed. Proposed manifest flags: allow_external_fallback: false, fallback_targets: ["dedicated","hosted"], require_kms_match: true.
anya: What about a probe step to validate hosted variant before routing? avoids full request failures.
lee: Probe must be authenticated, low-perf, and recorded. Add probe_result header and probe_latency to logs.
sam: Also we need a clear downgrade policy for model variants: prefer same-arch quant reductions first, then smaller size models. Document priority list.
infra-bot: perf-tests queued: fallback-probe-path (staging) https://ci/redwood/11888
anya: Action items: anya: draft manifest snippet + opt-in wording (due Tue). sam: write variant-priority doc (due Wed). lee: adapter enforcement + telemetry fields (due Thu).
anya: Keeping default conservative: no auto network fallback. Will loop in legal for opt-in wording.
